shortDescription: Framework for entad items: randomly rolled traits by rarity that modify stats, damage, abilities and buildings, stay hidden until revealed, and make every entad more durable by its highest rarity.
body:
## Durability
- Every item with at least one entad trait gets its MaxHitPoints multiplied by `EntadSettings.Durability[highest trait rarity]`. Defaults: Common x1.25, Uncommon x1.5, Rare x2, Epic x3, Legendary x5. Each is adjustable from 1 to 10 in the settings (General tab), and "Reset to defaults" covers them. The multiplier is applied last in `StatPart_Entad.TransformValue` and is never hidden.
- The MaxHitPoints explanation includes "Entad durability (Rarity): xN%", but vanilla's info-card Hit points row never shows stat explanations. The user is fine with that.
- HP keeps its health fraction on trait add/remove (`RescaleHitPoints`), when the settings window closes mid-game (`EntadMod.WriteSettings` → `EntadUtility.RescaleDurability`, every map and caravan), and on load (`SyncDurability`, against the saved `scaledDurability`, default 1 for old saves). A full-health item snaps to the new maximum.
- MaxHitPoints is always injected but stays immutable; every real change calls `ClearCacheForThing`.

## Furniture mood (EntadMoods.cs)
- Prefix on `Pawn_JobTracker.CleanupCurrentJob`. Counts as "used":
  - The job's building (targetA) for a bill, Research or a joy job, once the job Succeeded or the pawn is on the building's interaction cell. A finished bill often ends at a stockpile, so position alone isn't enough.
  - A sittable building under the pawn when seated: on the used building's interaction cell, at the end of a completed joy job at a building without one (TV), or after a meal that Succeeded.
  - The bed from `pawn.CurrentBed()` for LayDown / LayDownAwake / LayDownResting.
  - The eating surface after a Succeeded Ingest.
- Walking across, cleaning, hauling, walks and skygazing never count.
- Stacking: `Thought_EntadFurniture` records the building's `thingIDNumber` (saved as `entadSourceId`). The same building renews its own memory; different buildings and equipped items stack up to the thought's stackLimit (Contentment: 3). At the cap a new building replaces the oldest furniture memory; equipped-item memories (`Thought_EntadEquipped`, permanent) are never displaced, and `SyncEquipped` trims furniture memories to make room for them.
- Used only for plain memory thoughts (`def.ThoughtClass == Thought_Memory`); anything else goes through ThoughtMaker as before.

## Wearer stats (EntadWearerStats.cs)
- Entad trait offsets on pawn stats reach the holder through a postfix on `StatWorker.StatOffsetFromGear`. `StatPart_Entad` skips those offsets on apparel/equipment so they aren't counted twice.
- Offsets display in the stat's unfinalized style (`Worker.ValueToString(v, false, Offset)`), as vanilla does: ShootingAccuracyPawn offsets are skill levels (Steady Hands 1–4, Marksman's Eye 2–5).
- "Relevant gear": a [ThreadStatic] `explainingPawn` lets `GearAffectsStat` list only items with a non-zero revealed offset.

## Hiding unrevealed traits in displays
Gameplay always applies every trait. Three thread-static flags make displays leave hidden ones out: `displayExcludesHidden` (gear line), `gearCardThing` (item's equipped-offset rows), `infoCardThing` (item info card, every stat except MaxHitPoints). The card finalizer clears the item's and holder's trait stat caches every frame. Hidden traits count toward market value as the flat "unidentified" bonus.

## Startup
- `EntadCompInjector` adds `CompProperties_Entad` to every compatible ThingWithComps def and builds a per-def-index table (`MayHaveComp`), which `StatPart_Entad` and `IsEntadGearDef` use to skip the comp lookup for everything else.
- `EntadStatPartInjector` adds `StatPart_Entad` to every stat a trait references plus MarketValue and MaxHitPoints, then applies each `[HarmonyPatch]` class in its own try/catch.
- `EntadAbilityPrep` copies abilities per trait (psycasts, custom charges/cooldown/cast time). Copies get `ResolveDefNameHash`, a unique short hash via ShortHashGiver, and the short-hash dictionary is rebuilt. Reflection targets are looked up null-safe so a renamed vanilla field degrades instead of aborting.

## Building properties
- Fuel/glow/power/heat factors come from `CompEntad.PropertyFactor`; reveal checks use a `hiddenPropertyMask` bitmask. Original refuelable props are kept on the comp (`originalRefuelableProps`). Glow changes re-register via `CompGlower.ForceRegister` only on trait add/remove, never on reveal (a reveal can happen inside `RegisterGlower`).

## Weapons
- Extra damage: `Projectile.Impact` postfix (non-bullets) and `Bullet.Impact` postfix, since Bullet calls base.Impact before its own damage.

## Reveal triggers (EntadStatReveal.cs)
- Every trigger first checks `HasHiddenGear`. Learn: trickle XP (< 1) only on the pawn's 250-tick hash tick; one-off grants (shots, melee, social) always.

## Meals
- `[ThreadStatic] eating` flag around `Thing.Ingested` (prefix + finalizer) so the ThoughtsFromIngesting postfix only runs for real meals, not food scoring.

## API (EntadApi.cs)
- Request objects are never modified. Trait-count overloads pass the count through private overloads. Rejected generation candidates are dropped, not Discarded.
- Removed (breaking, unused anywhere): `EntadTraitDef.discoveryMessage`, `BaseMarketValue`, the range `Normalize` methods; `Roll()` is private.

## Content
- Trait labels are Title Case in the XML (no runtime recasing).
- Restful (furniture) gives the Restful Sigh ability: `Entad_RestfulCalm`, pain x0.5 for 4 hours (Ability_Duration 167 s), once a day.
- Frostbite is extra Frostbite damage (2–6), not a damage-type change.
- Steady Surgeon uses MedicalSurgerySuccessChance (pawn stat).

## Build setup
- net472, Krafs.Rimworld.Ref 1.6.4871 pinned, Lib.Harmony 2.4.1 compile-only; no publicizer (private members via `___field` injection and reflection). modVersion 1.0.0.

## Open items
- Def hot-reload doesn't re-run the injectors.
- The settings rescale doesn't refresh a spawned building's repair listing.
- Pending: translation keys (Languages/English/Keyed), Forge Frenzy-style settings tabs.

## Dev tools
- "Add specific Entad trait" lists applicable traits first, then the rest, alphabetically within each group.
